Build prompt

Build “Trivia Night Live Scoreboard & Answer Submitter” on NeoApps for a trivia host. Collect answers by team, lock each round and publish the host-approved leaderboard. Use invitations and scope records to this group. Include a demo with fictional records.

Acceptance test

Award 3 and 2 points over two rounds. The team has 5 points and closed answers stay locked.
